keys.prompt:
Make ONE precise production keyframe sheet of NINE sequential animation illustrations. EXACTLY 3 columns and 3 rows of 512x512 SQUARE cells, total 1536x1536; read row major. Invisible equal grid divisions, absolutely no written text, numbers, lettering, panel frames or gutters. Each cell has exactly the same fixed lens, solid opaque pure WHITE background, mild safe margins and fixed ground line. Draw the reference character(s) large, with the same recognizable face design, costume, hair and accessories across the 9 cells. Only characters requested in the story. Draw graphic chibi animation cels with clean shapes, not a close-up collage, no motion blur. Each cell must show a DIFFERENT complete acting pose. This is one story with a readable pay-off and reset, including hands, gaze and props. At small chat scale every pose reads. STORY: Silent partner dance. X on left and N on right face each other, take a small bow, sidestep past each other with X nearer the camera, arrive visibly exchanged, look back; reverse the arc past each other, return to their original positions. Medium full shot for footwork; keep bodies individually readable.
NINE chronological drawings: 1) 0.00 s: Draw X on the left and N on the right, facing each other upright, feet together and open hands beside their hips. 2) 0.55 s: Draw both making a small bow toward each other, heads lowered, knees soft and hands beside their thighs. 3) 1.10 s: Draw both rising and sidestepping inward, X diagonally forward and right, N diagonally back and left, eyes meeting. 4) 1.65 s: Draw X passing rightward in the foreground and N leftward behind, with lateral spacing keeping both bodies, feet and hands readable. 5) 2.20 s: Draw X clearly on the right and N on the left, feet planted and torsos angled outward, looking back over their shoulders at each other. 6) 2.75 s: Draw both pivoting inward to reverse their paths, X stepping left along the foreground arc and N right along the background arc. 7) 3.30 s: Draw X passing leftward in front and N rightward behind, heads turned toward each other and silhouettes clearly separated. 8) 3.85 s: Draw X reaching the original left mark and N the original right mark, trailing feet drawing inward and torsos turning toward each other. 9) 4.40 s: Draw both facing each other at their original marks, feet close, heels slightly raised and knees softly bent, ready to settle upright into pose one.
Continuity: Use one silent 4.8-second loop with a fixed medium full shot, consistent identities, no props, continuously visible hands and feet, connected gaze changes, and a smooth settling motion from pose nine into pose one. ATTACHMENT AUTHORITY: the left subject is directly illustrated from the real Bilibili official pack Xingtong 好欸好欸 and 对对对: use her squat round silver-grey bob shape, big angular silver side-swept bang, small loop-shaped crossing slim hairpins on the viewer-right, dark plum tapered ink, broad warm red cheeks, low-set eyes with lively lash detail, dark navy sleeves and white sailor collar with powder-blue trim. Closely follow the shape and color blocks in the small original stickers. Omit their printed writing and onomatopoeia. Do not use generic idol character design. Where the reference shows no pupils for a gag, preserve that deliberate feature in the nod; ordinary open eyes of Xingtong are blue. Nailü, whenever requested, uses the taupe, green, white-flower figure at RIGHT of the guide. Do not draw the attachment collage as a new scene. Nailü has exactly ONE brown HEART-SHAPED COWLICK attached to the top of the head. Hair flowers and green bang streak match the right-side guide; absolutely NO floating green wavy symbols above her head. Her eye direction and smiles vary with the scene.

strip-0.prompt:
Act as a senior 2D inbetween animator. Return a continuous production sheet in EXACTLY the same layout as this reference: THREE columns, FOUR rows, TWELVE equally sized complete square images, read left-to-right top-to-bottom. Fill every square with one fully drawn camera-locked scene. Its white background, screen coordinates, character scale, clothing and props agree with the reference. No grids, numbering, words, motion trails, crossfades or double hands. The attached four rows give A, B, B, C. Create TWO successive micro-actions: top TWO rows are SIX evenly spaced DIFFERENT complete inbetween poses from the first reference A toward B, bottom TWO rows are SIX from B toward C. The six progress values in EACH block are about 10%,26%,42%,58%,74%,90%. Source extremes are supplied separately in the final GIF, so fill ALL cells with precision motion, never six identical drawings. Follow bright clean line art and maintain exact registration and hand identity; no autonomous camera shake. Full story for context: Silent partner dance. X on left and N on right face each other, take a small bow, sidestep past each other with X nearer the camera, arrive visibly exchanged, look back; reverse the arc past each other, return to their original positions. Medium full shot for footwork; keep bodies individually readable.
A = 0.00 s: Draw X on the left and N on the right, facing each other upright, feet together and open hands beside their hips.
B = 0.55 s: Draw both making a small bow toward each other, heads lowered, knees soft and hands beside their thighs.
C = 1.10 s: Draw both rising and sidestepping inward, X diagonally forward and right, N diagonally back and left, eyes meeting.
Trust the actual illustrated poses in the attachment for the shape, timing and exact action. Preserve figure count and source costume. Never place hands, limbs or extra flowers into adjacent cells.
